features.title: Shot by shot breakdown
features.what: It explains how the visuals, text, editing and audio of a clip were made.
features.evidence_quote: give it any of them, and it tells you shot by shot how the visuals, styled text, editing and audio were made, then gives you a plan to make one yourself.

features.title: Every kind of video
features.what: Live footage, AI video, avatars, 3D and code motion are each judged on their own.
features.evidence_quote: Each shot judged separately, then reassembled on the original timeline

features.title: Evidence and rebuilt prompts
features.what: The report carries per-shot frames, the evidence and a prompt for each shot.
features.evidence_quote: a full report.html with per-shot frames, evidence, prompts, camera and lighting notes, and the audio breakdown

features.title: A remake plan
features.what: The plan separates what to film, what to generate and what to code.
features.evidence_quote: a remake plan, split into what to film, what to generate and what to code

features.title: Runs inside your agent
features.what: The agent installs the CLI and runs the whole breakdown itself.
features.evidence_quote: The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing.

features.title: Detailed docs are in Chinese
features.what: The long-form documentation is Chinese today; the report can be English.
features.evidence_quote: The detailed docs are in Chinese for now; your agent reads them and answers in your language.

risks.text: Detailed documentation is in Chinese for now; ask for English reports with the language flag.
A video-capable model makes the live/AI calls more accurate, and without one some shots are uncertain.
